data.name: Kunaafah

data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'kunnaf', meaning to protect or defend. In Islamic tradition, it is a beautiful name for a girl. The name Kunaafah carries the meaning “Protector or defender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kunaafah usually hope their child will grow to embody protector or defender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kunaafah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector or defender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kunaafah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.name: Kunaafah
in_english.meaning: meaning of Kunaafah is a pale or faint color, symbolizing death or demise
in_english.long_meaning: Kunaafah is an Arabic name that refers to the pale or faint color that covers the body after death, which is considered a sign of suicide in Islamic tradition. The name originates from the Arabic root K-N-F, which means pale or faint. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah al-Qasas, verse 77. In Islamic culture, the name Kunaafah is used to describe the pale or faint color that covers the body after death, and is considered a sign of suicide and eternal life in the afterlife.

data.cultural_impact: The Kunaafah is a popular Middle Eastern dish made of layered thin sheets of dough, Cheese and meat filling, baked until golden and crispy. When it comes to the Islamic name, Kunaafah, it is not uncommon to draw a parallel between the repeated layering of this scrumptious dish and the protective nature of the name. This link is particularly emphasized during the Ramadan season when special Kunaafah is prepared, representing a sense of togetherness and unity within the Muslim community. These layers serve as a metaphor for the protection and support that families and communities offer to one another, much in line with the interpretative meaning of the name.
data.spiritual_significance: In religious terms, this name symbolizes the protection that Allah offers to us through His guidance and love. It calls to mind the Proverb from the Holy Quran: "Verily Allah has sent down the Belief as a confirmation in what was [already] there - a light (Prophet Muhammad SAW), giving guidance to mankind and clear proofs about Allah's Oneness, and as a distinguishing criterion." (Surat Al-Maidah, 5:15) The name Kunaafah signifies a shield and a fortress, inspiring the individuals given this name to reflect upon the spiritual aspect of being protected by the divine will of Allah. It highlights the importance of the believer's continued faith and devotion and the unwavering strength and support that Allah's love provides in the spiritual life.
